claims.statement: Assume s3(A)>=1, max_i |A_ii|<1/64, and the completed fleet02/B20 r52 all-sign physical-pair gate has not paid the law. Then every off-diagonal original-coordinate entry satisfies |A_ij|<1/64+kappa0=0.01568575614261408114..., where kappa0=6.075614261408114e-5.
For symmetric zero-diagonal O with s3(O)>=sigma>0 and rho=max_i ||Oe_i||_2<sigma, the ordered disjoint 2x2 tetrad energy obeys W2(O)>=3 sigma^2 (sigma^2-rho^2).

Under s3(A)>=1, max_i|A_ii|<1/64, and failure of the fleet02/B20 r52 all-sign pair terminal, either every physical row star is <=1007/4096 and some literal full physical cut M has e2(MM^T)>=0.16507156335592299, with either e3(MM^T)>=2^-24 (full law paid by the existing physical-E3 theorem) or dist_F(M,rank<=2)<0.0010407934422325723; or some literal hub has fifteen pairwise-disjoint leaf groups, each carrying squared hub mass between rho^2/16 and rho^2/15 and hence arm norm >1007/16384, while every individual coefficient is <0.015685756142614082.

Pay, without deleting any retained coefficient tail, either the fixed-E2 ultrathin rank-two physical cut endpoint or the fifteen-arm diffuse-star endpoint by jointly spending the remaining third spectral resource; preserve separate shared-bank modulation and r52 finite-carrier endpoints.
